name: TokenField
summary: Edits a list of inline tokens; Enter turns typed text into a token.

useWhen: Entering tags, mentions, or structured tokens

obligations: Relate the label and input to inline tokens.
Expose disabled and read-only state and normalized values.

behavior: Controlled and uncontrolled Core string token arrays are supported.
Backspace removes the adjacent token when focused.
Typed text stays a draft until Enter, which trims each typed text run and turns it into a token in place; blank drafts are ignored. Comma has no special meaning, and duplicate tokens are kept.
onChange and named form submission report only the token array, and onChange fires only when the tokens change.
accessibility: Relate the label and input to inline tokens.
Expose disabled and read-only state and normalized values.

requirements.reason: Native dynamic colors do not apply to the React web binding.
Native font metrics do not apply to the React web binding.
